SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No.
& S. C. REGS.
Special Branch No. 2. Station,
o. S. B. D. 7639.
Date October 7, 1930.
ate 9 - 10 - 30.

REPORT

Subject (in full) G. Dobrovsky, Special Constable No. 81.

Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky. Forwarded by Whounean DSJ

Sir,
G. Dobrovsky, Russian, 22 years of age, single,
resides with his parents at No. 68 Route Vallon, Apart 6.
He has been employed as a clerk for about three years
at "Kelly & Walsh," No. 12 Nanking Road. He was educated
in Shanghai and speaks English fluently. He was a member
of "B" Company S.V.C. for about three years and only
recently resigned and joined the S.M.P. Special Constables
for which he was recommended by Mr. Vilensky (see attached
file). D 530

There is nothing in Police records to his
detriment.

J. Tcheremshansky
D. S.

D. C.
(C. & S. Branches)

E. C. P.
Information and favour of
return.
M.
7:10:30.

Please file.
M.
7:10:30

（左侧页边批注：Eur M 1930）

日期：1930年10月7日。
日期：30年10月9日。

报告

事由（全称）：G. Dobrovsky，特别警员第81号。

呈报人：D.S. Tcheremshansky。转呈人：Whounean DSJ

敬启者：
G. Dobrovsky，俄籍，22岁，未婚，
与其父母同住于瓦隆路（Route Vallon）68号6室。
他在南京路12号“凯利与沃尔什公司”（Kelly & Walsh）担任职员约三年。他在上海受教育，英语流利。他曾是万国商团（S.V.C.）“B”连成员约三年，最近才辞职并加入工部局警务处（S.M.P.）特别警员队，此职位由维伦斯基先生（Mr. Vilensky）推荐（见附件档案）。D 530

警方记录中并无对其不利之记载。

J. Tcheremshansky
副巡官（D. S.）

副总巡（D. C.）
（刑事及特务科）

助理总巡（E. C. P.）
供阅知并惠予退回。
M.
30年10月7日。

请归档。
M.
30年10月7日

（左侧页边批注：* 见特务科档案 D 530）
